Representation.Label: Anisosticta novemdecimpunctata
Representation.Detail:
Water ladybird

Body elongate and rather flattened. Ground colour buff with yellowish or reddish tinge. Nine black spots on each elytron in addition to scutellary spot. Six black spots, which may be fused, on pronotum.

Representation.Label: Psyllobora vigintiduopunctata
Representation.Detail: Elytra bright yellow, with 11 evently spaced discrete round black spots on each. Pronotum with 5 discrete black marks.

Representation.Label: Chilocorus bipustulatus
Representation.Detail:
heather ladybird

Marks form a thin red band or row of 3 (2-4) small spots across middle of the elytron. Body highly domed with lip around sides.

Representation.Label: Exochomus quadripustulatus
Representation.Detail:
pine ladybird

Pronotum entirely black. Forward mark curved (thicker at rear than at front and just in from the marginal lip. Second mark round, just behind center. Almost circular, with a definite lip around the edge of the elytra.

Representation.Label: Chilocorus renipustulatus
Representation.Detail:
kidney-spot ladybird

Pronotum entirely black. Single large bright red or orange spot centrally on each elytron. Legs black. Body almost circular with definite lip at edge.

Representation.Label: Adalia bipunctata f. typica
Representation.Detail:
2-spot ladybird

Legs and underside of the abdomen black.

Representation.Label: Anatis ocellata
Representation.Detail: Distinctive marks on pronotum. Black spots which are often ringed with cream or yellow.

Representation.Label: Calvia quatuordecimguttata
Representation.Detail:
Cream-spot ladybird

Ground colour brown or reddish brown with 7 white, off-white, or cream spots on each elytron, 3 of which form an irregular band across the fore half of the elytron.

Representation.Label: Coccinella hieroglyphica
Representation.Detail:
hieroglyphic ladybird

White flashes on the front of the elytra (either side of the scutellum). White on pronotum front corners triangular in shapes.

Representation.Label: Coccinella quinquepunctata
Representation.Detail: 2 spots on each elytron in addition to scutellary spot, the largest one central, the other behind the middle and near the edge of the elytron. Body almost round.

Representation.Label: Coccinella magnifica
Representation.Detail:
Scarce 7-spot ladybird

Two small triangular white marks at each side on underside of thorax, one under each of the middle and hind pairs of legs.
Elytra drop almost vertically at the sides and back, producing a humped profile.
Front angles of the pronotum somewhat rounded.
3-4 spots on each elytron in addition to scutellary spot, central and hind spots distinctly broader than they are long.

Representation.Label: Coccinella undecimpunctata
Representation.Detail: 5 spots on each elytron in addition to scutellary spot. Body somewhat elongate.

Representation.Label: Coccinella septempunctata
Representation.Detail: 7-spot ladybird

Representation.Label: Hippodamia tredecimpunctata
Representation.Detail: Elongate, about twice as long as broad. Pronotum with characteristic pattern.

Representation.Label: Myrrha octodecimguttata
Representation.Detail:
18-spot ladybird

Pattern on pronotum and at front end of elytra consistent and disctinctive. Ground colour of elytra and pronotum dark red-brown or maroon with off-white marks.

Representation.Label: Myzia oblongoguttata
Representation.Detail:
Striped ladybird

Grond colour of elytra rich orange-red or chestnut, with rich cream or yellow stripes along the elytra. Large.

Representation.Label: Propylea quatuordecimpunctata f. weisei
Representation.Detail:
14-spot ladybird

Elytra yellow with distinctly squarish or rectangular black marks. There are 7 spots on each elytron but they are usually fused so the number of spots cannot be counted.
Black pronotum marks usually fused into single black splodge spreading forward from rear edge of pronotum.
Undeside mainly black. Legs orange.

Representation.Label: Henosepilachna argus
Representation.Detail:
bryony ladybird

Large (5-7mm), with a scutellary spot and 5 black spots on each elytron

Representation.Label: Subcoccinella vigintiquatuorpunctata f. typica
Representation.Detail:
24-spot ladybird

Small (3-4 mm), without scutellary spot and 0-12 black spots on each elytron
